subject: [PATCH 37/60] mm/page_alloc: keep private memory out of reclaim reserves

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: This patch introduces a new concept of private memory and its exclusion from reclaim reserves. It modifies the calculation of total reserve pages and watermark settings to account for private memory.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve memory management in the Linux kernel by excluding private memory from reclaim reserves. The goal is to prevent private memory from being used for general system allocations, which can lead to issues such as double-put bugs and incorrect watermark settings.
